title: Finish setting up
summary: Had Tikka before the new version? Three quick answers and your page, bookings and Today are ready.

steps.title: Open Finish setting up
steps.body: Today shows "Finish setting up" at the top until it's done. Tap it. Nothing you set up before is lost: your page, services, photos, drops and customers are all still there.

steps.title: Say what you do
steps.body: Pick everything you do: hair, makeup, nails, lashes and brows, barbing, spa, gele, photography, videography or content. Customers find you by these in Tikka's search.

steps.title: Say where you work
steps.body: At your shop, salon or studio; you go to customers; or both. If you go to customers, set your travel fee and how far you'll go: your area, your city or your whole state.

steps.title: Pick your booking rules
steps.body: Customers see these before they book, like how much notice you need to move a booking and what happens to the deposit if they cancel. Tap a rule to change its words, or add your own. Then tap "Save and open Today".

tips: You can change all of this later: what you do on Your page, where you work and the rules in Booking settings.
